items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: JEN is supposed to be in Louisville. I don’t even know if they’re going to have JEN.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Oh I did — a friend of mine we’ve been doing a string of shows outside in her backyard so I went down to play that. And then there was a guy that wants me to come up and do a jazz clinic in Minnesota, but you know you don’t even know if you’re going to have this stuff. You know JEN is supposed to be in Louisville. I don’t even know if they’re going to have JEN. So everything is kind of up in the air.
Definitely. Well let’s hope for the best and be positive, as you have said a number of times today.
